CD38+ effector NK cells may be the target of Dara therapy and that the loss of CD38 on these cells may contribute to the development of immune dysfunction in MM.

The main takeaway from our work is that
Dara induces a rapid CD38 protein downregulation on NK cells that is associated with an increase in their effector functions, which is a novel mechanism of Dara immune activation.
Dara induces immune modulation by targeting CD38+ NK effector cells, and that the immune modulation is associated with the ability to degrade CD38 on these cells.
